يحتشيا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَشِيَا (yaḥtašiyā) /jaħ.ta.ʃi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
# يُحْتَشَيَا (yuḥtašayā) /juħ.ta.ʃa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَشَى (iḥtašā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
